settings.heading: Furniture made to be kept
settings.text: Alegria is a small, considered furniture studio working in oak, walnut, stone, wool and brass.

Alegria was founded on a simple belief: that the objects we live with should be made slowly, honestly and to last.

We work with a small circle of makers — joiners, upholsterers, ceramicists and weavers — who share our patience for natural materials and quiet detail. Our ranges stay deliberately small, so that every piece can be considered, repaired and handed down.

From a solid oak dining table to a hand-loomed wool throw, each Alegria piece is designed to settle into a home and improve with time. We believe good furniture is not consumed. It is kept.

settings.heading: Honest materials, natural finishes
settings.text:
European white oak and American walnut, honed travertine, natural wool and linen, and solid brushed brass. We finish with hard-wax oils and matte lacquers that protect the timber while letting its character show.

Our furniture is built with traditional joints and replaceable components, so that a well-loved piece can be refreshed rather than replaced.
